comment: Pins for the C/C++ corpus check (ADR-DEVKB-008 §7). Clones are shallow, go to DEVKB_CPP_CORPUS (default ~/.cache/devkb/cpp-corpus) and are refused unless HEAD is the pinned commit. Recall floors are QA's first measurement minus 0.02; floors move up only. First measurement: devkb/bench/cpp_corpus_first_measurement.json. ADR-DEVKB-009: `by_language` floors are QA's first per-language measurement minus 0.02 (precision 0.95); `by_source.extern-c` is the precision floor of the `extern-c` edges. First per-language measurement, 2026-11-16 (regex truth, `devkb.bench.cpp_truth`): cJSON c R 0.9677; fmt c 1.0 / cpp 0.60; leveldb c 1.0 / cpp 0.569; autoas c 0.8202 / cpp 0.65; zephyr c 0.8058 / cpp 0.5714.

reference_machine.cpu: 12 logical cores, x86_64 Linux 7.0 (as run by the author; QA must restate the reference machine)
reference_machine.status: open: QA states the reference machine

vendored.comment: Directory prefixes (relative to the repository root, whole path components) holding code copied into the tree from another project. SPEC-DKB-004 F1: excluded from the compiler truth and from the score alike. A file is vendored if its path equals a prefix or lies below it.

adjudication_repos.comment: SPEC-DKB-004 story 1: the third C++ repository of the adjudicated sample (small, non-template-heavy, single translation unit). Not a floor-checked corpus repository.
adjudication_repos.name: tinyxml2

dependency_exemptions.mcp: optional extra `mcp` (pyproject.toml [project.optional-dependencies]); imported by devkb/mcp_server.py only
dependency_exemptions.scipy: optional extra `study`; imported by the benchmark analysis only
dependency_exemptions.readiness_gate: factory script imported lazily inside a function at process_api.py, absent outside the factory
